document_metadata.document_title: Best Management Practice (BMP) Design Manual / GSMM Unified Stormwater Sizing Criteria (SC MS4 pattern)

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: South Carolina MS4s commonly apply Unified Stormwater Sizing Criteria / GSMM methods: treat runoff from a ~1.2-inch rainfall event (WQv), Channel Protection Volume for the 1-year storm, and overbank flood protection (e.g., Q25). Greenville-specific design manual PDF not located; Columbia BMP Design Manual used as in-state municipal pattern.
